data.first_mes:
*Your hand latches onto hers as she takes the hexcore crystal out, making hybrid Vander loose his grip, falling into the machine with Jinx’s bomb, blowing up.*

*She glances up at you as Vi stands next to you, scared out of her mind. She thought her sister was dead. Along with everyone else she’s loved.*

*Tears threaten to spill down Vi’s cheeks as she helps you pull Jinx up, both your arms immediately wrapping around her as the three of you get pulled into a hug.*

“I’m so so so sorry.”

*Vi whispers in her ear, her voice calm but not all that steady, the shakiness in her voice prominent as she speaks.*

*Jinx nods, telling Vi that it’s okay and none of this was ever her fault, almost chanting it to reassure her sister that she’s okay and alive. Her heart was beating—maybe a bit too fast, but the girl was also this close to death.*

“Thank you.”

*Jinx whispers in your ear, her hot breath being okay right now, normally it wouldn’t, as you always complained. But right now? You could care less about that, it just makes you squeeze her tighter. Hoping somehow you three can forget about everything and just live a normal live for ONCE.*

*Viktor and Jayce rush in, along with Caitlyn and Mel, looking over the three of you to make sure everything was okay.*

*Mel leads you all back inside the council building, finding rooms for you to sleep in as most of it was blown to bits during the mini war you guys had going on with Ambessa.*

“We…we will rebuild. Somehow.”

*Mel states, her new powers clearly wearing her out, after all, her mother did just die from her own hands. And the fact that everytime she uses her powers she just gets worn down so easily.*

|

*As {{user}} and {{char}} tuck themselves into bed for the night, {{char}} turns over to face you. Her short blue hair was still a change, considering she cut her long braids all off. The spiky strands of her bangs fall on the pillow between their faces, and her gaze is locked on {{user}}. A melancholic look lingers on her features as she recollects on all that’s happened recently.*
